name: outreachai-root
description: Root dev runner for OutreachAI — starts Node server, Next.js client, and Python Resume Optimizer

scripts.dev: concurrently --names "NODE,CLIENT,OPTIMIZER" --prefix-colors "cyan,magenta,yellow" "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client" "npm run dev:optimizer"
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd server && npm install && cd ../client && npm install
